evidence: Gate dimensions carry the real hard gate: scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0 (identical to template); test.sh runs the gates suite first (line 213) and score.py:41 requires every gate score > 0 and score.py:48 zeroes the reward otherwise; both gate judge.toml use aggregation all_pass with one binary criterion. Render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:20-35, authenticated_render): reachable, real Kittle & Rowe matter chat not blank/static mock/generic or fatal error, nothing private before sign-in (public brief instruction.md:7), wrong password rejected (template-mandated leg), gwen@kittle.test/password123 opens her matters and messages. Constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:55-72, server_backed_local_application): gwen posts 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' in M-11, reloads, then harriet in a separate browser context sees it - an actual successful write plus independent-context readback, so a localStorage/static-shell/client-only facade fails, as REVIEW_POLICY requires. Same-origin is NOT required: both gate prompts and judge texts say 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure' / 'must not fail this gate'; the requirement is only that the app is reached from localhost:3000 and that matter data is server-held, which the brief states (integration.md:36,42). Every scored prompt restates the in-dimension gate with a hard zero: functional/prompt.md:11-19, polish/prompt.md:10-18, visual/prompt.md:18-26 - load from localhost:3000 without fatal error, gwen can sign in and see protected content 'appropriate to the current state', blank page/empty workspace/static mock/static shell/missing backend fails, 'If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension'. No scored prompt assigns partial credit on gate failure; polish/visual 'Independent scoring' sections say the gate is the only all-or-nothing rule. Auth and backing legs are present because the app has sign-in and a server. Gate accounts and matter are valid per seed (M-11 client gwen, harriet partner not walled; fixed clock means the posted gate message never ages out of the 7-day timer). In individual functional mode each session re-applies the gate with gwen, and 'appropriate to the current state' avoids zeroing a correct app after earlier criteria's walls/timers/deletions (walls only apply to staff, so gwen keeps M-11/M-13). Weak-app probe: a client-only or in-memory-per-tab app fails the cross-context readback; an app persisting only in server memory passes gates but is caught by the functional restart criterion, which is the correct split (lesson 4: keep difficulty in scored outcomes). Conforming-alternative probe: an app using CDN assets or a non-'M-11' URL scheme still passes since routes are never prescribed. Runtime: raw-evidence-index hashes all match current files and the frozen solution files match the indexed hashes; golden-run.log:2 'gate_constraints PASS' (scripted Playwright, functional.cjs:99-106). Residual risk (why risk=true): no configured LLM judge run of either gate or of the scored in-dimension gates exists (index scope: 'Full configured grading ... absent'); the render gate is not covered even by the scripted run. Minor wording note (P3, not a defect): the scored gate's phrase 'seeded-looking facade fails this gate' could tempt a judge to doubt a correct app that naturally shows seed data; it is qualified by 'real task data backed by the running local server' so I do not rate it a failure, but it is unmeasured.
